data.title: 空门苍 · 神社拜殿前的午后困意
data.description: 神社红色的鸟居在蝉鸣中投下斑驳的长影。苍手里的竹扫帚靠在廊柱旁，整个人蜷在木阶梯上打盹，侧马尾随着均匀的呼吸轻轻晃动，嘴角挂着满足的弧度。
data.location: weathered wooden steps of mountain shrine under grand vermilion torii gate and cedar trees
data.action: dozing off peacefully on shrine porch steps, bamboo broom leaning against vermilion post, sleeping with sweet curled lips and messy side ponytail
data.lighting: dappled golden sunbeams filtering through cedar needles onto scarlet hakama
data.mood: serene rustic peace, innocent sleepy vulnerability, warm lazy summer reverie
data.promptProse: Napping peacefully on ancient shrine steps in her miko vestments, blue-haired Ao curls up with a broom resting beside her under warm tree shadows.
data.animaCaption: She naps in the afternoon sunlight on the shrine steps, with the bamboo broom leaning against the post beside her.
